If you're not yet done troubleshooting, you can

  • Start a new search. Look-up a new set of RC 411, articles or troubleshooting guides
  • View all troubleshooting guides by category
  • Access the latest RC 411

You can also

  • Put additional case comments and/or upload files to your case
  • Update minor changes to the case that are limited to the following:
    • Subject
    • Description
    • Contact Email Address
    • Case Severity
    • InContact ID
  • Update the Knowledge Base article
  • Submit a new Knowledge Base article
  • Send a feedback about the RingCentral Troubleshooting Tool

Or if you're all set, you can choose Take me to my case.

SEARCH METHODS


Article search through RingCentral Support will provide an option to lookup Knowledge Base articles from the RingCentral Support Site (https://support.ringcentral.com) and use the information to attach articles that were used to your case.


Quick search quickly scans the titles of all reference materials based on your input. This is very useful if you know the RC 411 update number, internal article number, or part of the title of any RC 411, internal articles, and troubleshooting guides.


Intensive search thoroughly searches RC 411, internal articles, and troubleshooting guides even if you don't know the exact RC 411 update number or title. Simply use key phrases that best describe the issue.

fields.name: UpdateCaseNoArticleLanding_dt01
fields.fieldText:
YOUR CASE HAS BEEN SUCCESSFULLY UPDATED


You have just updated Case Number: {!var_case_selectedcasedetails.CaseNumber}. From here you can do the following:


If you're not yet done troubleshooting, you can

  • Start a new search. Look-up a new set of RC 411, articles or troubleshooting guides
  • View all troubleshooting guides by category
  • Access the latest RC 411

You can also

  • Put additional case comments and/or upload files to your case
  • Update minor changes to the case that are limited to the following:
    • Subject
    • Description
    • Contact Email Address
    • Case Severity
    • InContact ID
  • Submit a new Knowledge Base article
  • Send a feedback about the RingCentral Troubleshooting Tool

Or if you're all set, you can choose Take me to my case.
